def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    loan_amount = 300_000
    original_rate = 0.045
    new_rate = 0.04
    loan_term_years = 30
    float_down_fee_percent = 0.4

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    total_payments = loan_term_years * 12

    def monthly_payment(annual_rate):
        monthly_rate = annual_rate / 12
        return loan_amount * monthly_rate / (1 - (1 + monthly_rate) ** -total_payments)

    payment_savings = (
        monthly_payment(original_rate) - monthly_payment(new_rate)
    ) * total_payments
    fee = loan_amount * float_down_fee_percent / 100
    answer = round(payment_savings - fee)

    # Return answer
    return answer
